name: PBs in Palisades 2023

venue.name: Palisades Center
venue.address: 1000 Palisades Center Dr, West Nyack, NY 10994

information: The competition area is located on the first floor, east wing. The entrance is near the Cheesecake Factory. Each competitor registering with a guest will receive one guest pass that will allow entry into the competition area. Guest passes are transferable. If we encounter occupancy issues during peak hours (most likely 8:30am to 1:30pm), we will kindly ask guests without a guest pass to leave.
